courses.essential_material_review: All11 published puzzles have their complete local description/exercise PDF, an original captioned lesson video, Python examples and the publisher supplied solution for one exercise. Keep the original book citation and all publisher/copyright notices. This is the complete published two-week seminar, not a claim to supply the entire commercial book or solutions for every optional puzzle exercise. Running examples requires a Python interpreter; no cloud service, extra module or online dataset is referenced by the29 supplied source files.
